title: Holographic Open/Closed Exchange in Double Deeply Virtual Compton Scattering: Fixed-$j$ Structural Matching to the $\pm$-Basis Wilson Kernels
summary: We show that fixed--$j$ holographic double deeply virtual Compton scattering (DDVCS), and its DVCS limit, give a fixed-scale structural match to the singlet conformal-OPE Wilson-kernel family of QCD in the leading-twist unpolarized singlet vector channel. The open-string $C_1(δ,\vartheta)$ hypergeometric kernel was derived by Nishio--Watari; the new closed-string result is that the BPST upper Witten vertex gives the same family with a different near-boundary power count, because $Δ_c(j)$ is fixed by the BPST trajectory rather than by open-Regge data. The Mellin exponent is therefore derived…
